description:
### **Overall Figure Description**

This is a two-panel, double-column-width figure designed for a top-tier academic publication, embodying a clean, elegant, and professional aesthetic. The entire figure is set against a pure white background to maximize clarity and provide generous whitespace between all elements. A thin, very light gray vertical line subtly separates the two panels. All text is rendered in a classic Serif font for readability, with mathematical notations in Computer Modern. The figure employs a sophisticated and harmonious color palette of soft blues, greens, and warm earth tones. All rectangular boxes feature noticeably rounded corners and a very subtle drop shadow, giving them a slight lift and a soft, modern feel.

---

### **Panel (a): Training Setup**

This panel, occupying the left ~53% of the total width, illustrates the model's training architecture as a vertical flowchart that progresses from bottom to top. It is clearly labeled **(a) Training Setup** in the top-left corner.

**1. Input Layer (Bottom):**
*   **Component:** At the base of the diagram, a single, horizontally-centered rectangle is labeled "RGB Observation".
*   **Styling:** This box has a light, cool gray fill with a slightly darker cool gray border, and its label is in a smaller font size to indicate its role as the starting input.

**2. Encoder Layer (Middle-Bottom):**
*   **Components:** Two encoder boxes are positioned side-by-side above the input.
    *   The left box is labeled **DINOv2** with an italicized, gray subtitle below it reading "1024-d patches".
    *   The right box is labeled **SigLIP** with a matching italicized, gray subtitle reading "1152-d patches".
*   **Styling:** Both encoder boxes share a unified style: a soft sky blue fill with a medium slate blue border. The main labels are bold, with subtitles in a smaller, non-bold italic style.
*   **Connections:** Two separate, thin black arrows originate from the top of the "RGB Observation" box, diverging to point to the bottom of each respective encoder box.

**3. Backbone Layer (Middle):**
*   **Component:** A single, wide rectangle labeled **LLM Backbone** is centered above the two encoders, spanning their combined width. It has an italicized gray subtitle reading "Llama-2 7B + LoRA".
*   **Styling:** This central processing unit is distinguished by a warm off-white fill and a soft taupe border.
*   **Connections:** Thin black arrows emerge from the top of each encoder box and converge, pointing to the bottom center of the LLM Backbone box. A small, italic gray annotation, "concat (2176-d)", is placed precisely at this junction to denote the feature fusion.

**4. Output Heads (Top):**
*   **Components:** Two output head boxes branch from the LLM at the top of the diagram.
    *   **Action Head (Top-Left):** A box labeled **Action Head** with the subtitle "7-DoF tokens". Positioned directly above is a mathematical label, **_L_<sub>action</sub>**, rendered in a bold, muted kelly green.
    *   **Aux Head (Top-Right):** A box labeled **Aux Head** with the subtitle "BEV / Depth". Positioned directly above is a mathematical label, **λ(t) ⋅ _L_<sub>aux</sub>**, rendered in a bold, warm mustard gold. A small, rounded badge with a muted crimson border containing the text "BN/LN" is placed near the top-right of this box.
*   **Styling:**
    *   The Action Head box has a light mint green fill and a muted kelly green border.
    *   The Aux Head box has a pale peach fill and a warm mustard gold border.
*   **Connections:** Two thin black arrows diverge from the top of the LLM Backbone box, one pointing to the bottom of the Action Head and the other to the Aux Head.

**5. Key Annotations and Visual Elements:**
*   **Gradient Flow Arrow:** The visual centerpiece of this panel is a **dashed, muted crimson arrow** of a slightly heavier weight. It originates from the "Aux Head" and curves gracefully back down, pointing towards the "LLM Backbone" area, visually representing the paper's central research question.
*   **Gradient Flow Question:** Adjacent to this arrow is a prominent annotation box designed to draw the eye. It features a thin, muted crimson border, a light pink background, and contains the italicized text "**_gradient flow?_**" in the same crimson color.
*   **Inference Annotation:** Above the "Aux Head" box, a small note on a pale yellow background reads "_discarded at inference_" in italic gray. A small, thin arrow points from this note down to the Aux Head box, clarifying its role.

---

### **Panel (b): Factorial Design**

This panel, occupying the right ~45% of the figure, presents the 2x2 factorial experimental design in a clean, organized grid. It is labeled **(b) Factorial Design** in its top-left corner.

**1. Grid Layout and Headers:**
*   **Structure:** A 2x2 grid is framed by a single outer rounded rectangle with a light gray border and a subtle drop shadow. The internal grid lines are thin and a very light gray, ensuring clear but not distracting separation.
*   **Column Headers:** Positioned above the grid. The left column is headed by "**Gradient ON**" in a muted crimson color. The right column is headed by "**Gradient OFF**" in a dusty purple color. Both are bold.
*   **Row Headers:** Positioned to the left of the grid. The top row is labeled "**BN**" and the bottom row is labeled "**LN**". Both are bold in a deep navy color.

**2. Grid Cells:**
Each of the four cells contains an inner, centered, rounded box with a tinted background that corresponds to its column and row, creating a clear visual grouping.
*   **Top-Left (BN, ON):** Labeled "**Full OCC**". The text is muted crimson on a very light pink background.
*   **Top-Right (BN, OFF):** Labeled "**Detach OCC**". The text is dusty purple on a very light lavender background.
*   **Bottom-Left (LN, ON):** Labeled "**Full OCC+LN**". The text is warm mustard gold on a very light peach background.
*   **Bottom-Right (LN, OFF):** Labeled "**Detach+LN**". The text is soft taupe on a very light beige background.

**3. Supplementary Conditions:**
*   **Layout:** Below the main grid is a small section titled "**Additional:**" in bold. Four supplementary conditions are listed concisely in a two-column layout.
*   **Items:** Each item is marked by a small, solid colored square followed by its text label.
    *   `■` Random OCC (muted kelly green square)
    *   `■` Depth-only (goldenrod square)
    *   `■` Cutoff / Reverse (soft cyan square)
    *   `■` Vanilla (no aux) (medium slate blue square)

**4. Final Annotation:**
*   **Text:** At the very bottom of the panel, centered, is an italic gray text block summarizing the experimental scope:
    "_5 factors across 12 conditions:_"
    "_gradient flow / label content / normalization_"
    "_reference frame / temporal extent_"
